# ScrollContainer

Figma: [06k. ScrollContainer](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=4010-134463) · Family: 06 Navigation · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

A scrollable region with an optional custom Scrollbar, edge Fades, and sticky-edge Scroll shadows. Assembles from reusable atoms (Scrollbar · Fade · Scroll shadow) and reuses the Carousel PageIndicator (snap) and a Spinner (pull-to-refresh). RTL-aware (the horizontal origin + vertical scrollbar side flip via a Direction variant).

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/scroll-container/reference.png`

### Scrollbar

Track and thumb for scrollable areas, overlay or gutter model, thin or default, with idle, hover and dragging states.

Level: atom · Part of: ScrollContainer

Use when:
- Inside ScrollContainer to show scroll position on web and back-office panels
- Model=gutter where content must not sit under the thumb (tables)

Don't use when:
- Native mobile scroll: hide it (ScrollContainer showScrollbar off)
- Progress values: use ProgressBar

Accessibility: Visual only; the scroll region itself must be keyboard scrollable (tabindex and a label).

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Orientation | `orientation` | variant | vertical, horizontal | vertical |
| Thickness | `thickness` | variant | thin, default | thin |
| Model | `model` | variant | overlay, gutter | overlay |
| State | `state` | variant | idle, hover, dragging | idle |

### Fade

Edge gradient mask hinting that more content lies beyond the start or end of a scroll area; its stops are hardcoded from bg/surface and bg/elevated.

Level: atom · Part of: ScrollContainer

Use when:
- Edges of horizontal card rails and long lists (ScrollContainer fadeStart / fadeEnd)

Don't use when:
- Under sticky headers or above sticky footers: use Scroll shadow
- Image overlays: use the media's own scrim

Accessibility: Decorative; never fade over interactive content that must stay readable.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Edge | `edge` | variant | start, end | start |
| Surface | `surface` | variant | surface, elevated | surface |

### Scroll shadow

Shadow divider shown under a sticky header or above a sticky footer once content scrolls beneath it; reuses the Shadow / sm style.

Level: atom · Part of: ScrollContainer

Use when:
- Sticky header or footer inside ScrollContainer, sheets and long pages

Don't use when:
- Static separators: use Divider
- Scroll edge hints on rails: use Fade

Accessibility: Decorative.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Position | `position` | variant | top, bottom | top |

### Pull-to-refresh

Mobile pull-to-refresh indicator that swaps a spinner through idle, pulling and refreshing states at the top of a scroll area.

Level: molecule · Contains: SpinnerRing · Part of: ScrollContainer

Use when:
- Refreshing feeds such as deals, portfolio or updates on mobile

Don't use when:
- Web and back-office: use an explicit refresh Button
- Initial page load: use Skeleton blocks

Accessibility: Offer an alternative refresh action; announce 'Refreshing' and completion via a live region.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| State | `state` | variant | idle, pulling, refreshing | idle |

### Scroll content

Placeholder content for the ScrollContainer Content slot, to be swapped for the real list or rail.

Level: atom · Part of: ScrollContainer

Use when:
- Default slot filler before swapping in real content

Don't use when:
- Final designs: swap in List, ActionList, Carousel or your own component

Accessibility: Not applicable; replace before handoff.

_No properties._

### ScrollContainer

Clipped scrollable area that assembles Scrollbar, edge Fades and Scroll shadows around a swappable Content slot, vertical or horizontal, with RTL origin handling.

Level: organism · Contains: Scrollbar, Fade, Scroll shadow, Scroll content

Use when:
- Horizontal card rails such as deal or poster strips with fades at the edges
- Long lists inside fixed-height panels with sticky header or footer
- Back-office panels that need a visible scrollbar

Don't use when:
- Paged slides with an indicator: use Carousel
- Whole-page scroll: let the screen scroll natively

Accessibility: Scroll region must be focusable with an accessible name; in RTL horizontal scroll starts at the right and the vertical scrollbar sits on the left.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

Use it for any clipped, scrollable area: long lists, horizontal card rails, sheets. The container clips content and shows a scrollbar; fades and sticky-edge shadows hint that more content lies beyond the edge.

### Atomic architecture

- Scrollbar (A) - track + thumb. Orientation × Thickness × Model (overlay/gutter) × State (idle/hover/dragging).
- Fade (B) - edge scroll-mask gradient. Edge (start/end) × Surface (surface/elevated).
- Scroll shadow (C) - sticky header/footer divider shadow. Position (top/bottom); reuses the Shadow / sm style.
- Reused: Carousel PageIndicator (snap indicator) · Spinner (pull-to-refresh).

### A · Scrollbar

Thumb darkens idle → hover → dragging. Overlay floats over content; gutter reserves a track. thumbPosition (start/middle/end) is representative.

### B · Fade

A surface→transparent gradient masking the scroll edge. Edge is logical (flips under RTL). Built for both surfaces.

> **Warning:** The one place our “everything bound” rule breaks: Figma can’t bind gradient stops to a colour variable. The Fade’s stops are HARDCODED from bg/surface / bg/elevated (resolved values). If those surface tokens change, update the Fade stops manually.

### C · Scroll shadow

Shown under a sticky header (top) or above a sticky footer (bottom). Reuses the Shadow / sm effect style - no new shadow authored.

### D · ScrollContainer

Assembles the atoms. VARIANT axis × direction. BOOLEAN fadeStart · fadeEnd · stickyHeader · stickyFooter · showScrollbar. INSTANCE-SWAP Content (and swap the nested Scrollbar for overlay/gutter/thin, or hide it for native).

### Making it actually scroll

> **Info:** This is a visual assembly - to make an instance really scroll: (1) set the frame’s Overflow behaviour to match Axis (Vertical / Horizontal / Both) and enable Clip content; (2) fix sticky header/footer with “Fix position when scrolling”; (3) overscroll / bounce is prototype behaviour - document, don’t build.

### Scroll-snap & Pull-to-refresh

Snap indicator reuses the Carousel PageIndicator (active dot = snapped item). Pull-to-refresh (mobile) instance-swaps a Spinner: idle → pulling → refreshing.

### Direction - RTL

- Horizontal scroll origin reverses: content starts at the RIGHT and scrolls left. Fade start/end and snap origin flip.
- Vertical scrollbar moves to the LEFT in RTL (mirrors LTR) - confirmed for this system.
- That’s why direction is a VARIANT, not left to Figma auto-mirroring.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** Everything reuses existing tokens/atoms - the Shadow style, PageIndicator, and Spinner are all reused; only Scrollbar/Fade/Scroll shadow/ScrollContainer are new.

> **Warning:** bg/subtle does not exist in this DS - the subtle track/surface uses bg/disabled. The Fade gradient is the only intentionally-unbound colour.
